about: What is on the CMU robot today, on top of the assembly guide's whole-robot data (make_visual.py). Source: Shawn, 2026-10-20: torso shells and thighs are white, the back carries the two-converter box without its rear lid (bench supply), the ankles and feet are the V1.22 split ankle and slip-fit feet. Colours are the printed filament colours of colour scheme C (guide/print/colour-study-20261014/make_specs.py); the guide's own colours are display colours.

body_override_reasons.amplifier: sits in the head beside the speaker; nearest official mesh is the head-yaw link 4 mm closer than the head
body_override_reasons.idler12: motor 12 rides on the neck body, so its rear idler horn turns with the torso side like its output horn

part_files_reason: The guide data now carries the V1.24 two-half ankle (not printed). The robot wears the V1.22 split ankle (base on the horn, side with two M2 x 8 TAP, 10.4 mm black sleeve) and the V1.22 slip-fit feet: the world STLs of release-V1.22 (guide frame, mm).

jaw.open_positive: a positive angle about axis swings the lip tip down (opens)
jaw.source: guide/extension-20261012-neck-audio/neck-route/nr_lib.py JAW_PIVOT / JAW_AXIS (robot frame, mm), the hinge the jaw pose-cap study sweeps

battery.about: The 2S battery backpack (D-010, apply_masses variant battery): the bench converter box comes off, the backpack goes on.
